scope: Corollary 4.6 (Power-loss norm for compact arrays) of the manuscript “Endpoint pointwise convergence for the Schrodinger equation in higher dimensions” (preprints/Endpoint-pointwise-convergence-for-the-Schrodinger-equation-in-higher-dimensions-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 080 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4f859efa28f227ff), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 50. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let U be a compact array of scale L, and let µ satisfy (4.3) in a spacetime box of side O(L2). For every ε > 0, with sufficiently many fixed profile derivatives, X q µ(q)β sup q |U|2 ≤ Cεmβ L2n/(n+1)+ε E(U). (4.12)
